description: Validate a single email address: RFC syntax check, MX record lookup on the domain, disposable/temporary-email-provider detection, and role-account detection (info@, admin@, etc.). Per-address check — different from email_deliverability_check, which audits a whole domain's sending reputation (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR/DNSBL).
name: email_address_validate
